Results.ReviewText:
By far the best grill I have ever owned. 

I have had this grill for about two months and have used it about ten times. It pre-heats quickly and the internal temp stays very even. This definitely aids in keeping foods juicy with a nice outer char.

I bought this due to knowing of the high quality of Weber products. Also the fact that replacement parts are readily available when the time comes.

While Weber products tend to cost more than most competitors, this grill is well worth the relatively low increase in price. Simply based upon its excellent performance.

You will need some intermediate skills to assemble this grill or find a place that does assembly. Also, I do not like the shelf side that folds down. It seems overly flimsy and cheap on a grill at this price point. I modified mine so the shelf is static and solid.

Overall, great unit that will out-grill anything in its class. When You're ready to step up to a real grill, this is highly recommended

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Purchased 5 weeks ago.
Downsized from a 4 burner no name grill.
I enjoyed putting grill together, all pictures and no word on directions, and all parts were there. 
Go to light grill and wont go past 250 degrees.
Who designed this safety valve?
After contact Weber via email was told turn on tank wait 60 sec for gas to stabilise pressure, then light grill. Ok that fixed the pressure issue but now have to wait 60 sec every time i light the grill?? Seems odd all other grills i had lit within 10 sec. 
Heating grill up to 500 takes 3to 5 mins grill never gets to 600!!
Trying to cook at 350 degrees requires using only one burner. (If u use 2 burners the gas is set so low flame will go out).
So my issue with this grill is always adjusting for correct temperature, starting issues, and grill s flame going out.
Would i recommend a Weber nope!!
Any other grill i ever had a issue with i would contact the support and they would send me a part i needed Free.
Contact Weber support they tell u try this, try that, did you see our help website etc. Just fix the regulator issue and send me a new regulator so i dont have so many issues.
I say stay away!!!
Results.Title: I thought Weber was a good product.

When you try and lift that side, the tray raises up and is unstable as you try and lift the grill to roll it.  The second flaw is that the trim on the grill lid is the same color as the handle. Results.Title: Fun To Use

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This is my second Weber grill.  I also own a portable that is still working as well as the day I bought it.  My Sprit grill does a great job.  It heats up in minutes and is ready for cooking. 
 It is solid and well-constructed.  I saw other grills for less money but these are the ones that you eventually see on the side of the road waiting to be picked up by the trash man.  I have never seen a Weber grill being junked.  I also bought the Weber cover.  It fits perfectly and will keep my Spirit in like-new condition.  This grill will probably out live me.  Definitely worth the investment.

Results.Title: In love

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I've had this grill for a few months. I love it. It is the perfect size for my deck. I've smoked pig ears for my puppy, cooked a perfect steak, and slung burgers like it was my day job. The Weber Spirit II E-210 has made me realize that I needed a Weber three grills ago.

The open access below the grill and the collapsible side shelf are welcomed features. I got the iGrill3 as well. All is good. Summer has just reached the Boston area and I'm looking forward to more cooks!

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
